preregistered_prediction.full_vs_shuffled: full better than shuffled if reasoning is causal
preregistered_prediction.shuffled_vs_constant: shuffled ~ constant if content is irrelevant
preregistered_prediction.none: worst, if the channel contributes at all
preregistered_prediction.oracle: oracle better than full => channel can carry information
preregistered_prediction.interpretation: a null shuffled result is only interpretable if oracle shows the channel can carry information

notes: The positive control did not beat `full`: the steering vector could not carry information the input lacked. A null shuffle result is therefore uninterpretable and must not be reported as 'reasoning is decorative'.
shuffled ~ constant: content is irrelevant, only the presence of a steering vector matters.
